features.name: Hetao Hong Kong Park / HSITP
features.summary: Opened 22 December 2025. R&D and pilot production focus; later construction remains phased.

milestones.description: Remaining five first-batch buildings expected to become ready

features.location: Lok Ma Chau Loop, Hong Kong; south bank of Shenzhen River
features.boundary_warning: 87ha campus is not the 104ha statutory plan scheme. Use a pin unless a campus footprint is separately verified.

features.name: Hetao Shenzhen Park
features.summary: Includes Futian Free Trade Zone (1.35 km²) and Huanggang Port area (1.67 km²).

milestones.description: Full collaborative innovation pattern with Hong Kong Park

features.location: Futian District, north bank of Shenzhen River
features.boundary_warning: Do not equate entire Shenzhen Park with the much smaller HKSTP Shenzhen Branch.

features.name: Hong Kong Science Park Shenzhen Branch
features.summary: Two buildings completed in 2023; 31,000 m² gross floor area.
features.area_warning: 31,000 m² is gross floor area, not land area.

features.name: San Tin Technopole
features.summary: Current project page states 626ha including the 87ha Loop. Around 210ha additional I&T land beyond the Loop.
features.location: San Tin / Lok Ma Chau, northern New Territories
features.boundary_warning: Not all land is technology campus. Current project total, statutory planning area and older CSDI study boundary are different extents.

features.name: Northern Metropolis
features.summary: Regional programme covering Yuen Long and North districts, including existing towns and multiple development areas.
features.boundary_warning: Not 300 km² of newly built technology development. Do not sum nested HSITP/San Tin areas into this total.

features.name: Qianhai Shenzhen–Hong Kong Modern Service Industry Cooperation Zone
features.summary: Western Shenzhen service-industry and institutional cooperation zone.
features.location: Western Shenzhen, Pearl River Estuary coast
features.boundary_warning: Expanded Qianhai footprint is much larger than its original 14.92km² core; do not use the old core outline for the expanded total.

features.name: Hung Shui Kiu industry park
features.summary: 2026 plan calls for phased development of 27.5ha.
features.boundary_warning: Industry-park land is a subset of the larger Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen development area.

features.name: Lau Fau Shan Digital Technology Hub
features.summary: Approximately 30ha reserved in the 2026 plan.
features.boundary_warning: Reserved hub land is a subset of Lau Fau Shan development; do not use whole district polygon as the hub.

features.name: Sandy Ridge Data Facility Cluster
features.summary: 2026 plan targets operation by 2029.

features.name: Johor–Singapore Special Economic Zone
features.summary: Economic partnership with nine designated flagship areas situated wholly within southern Johor.
features.boundary_warning: Do not shade Singapore as inside the JS-SEZ. The partnership connects two economies; its designated land is in Malaysia.

features.name: Iskandar Malaysia
features.summary: Created in 2006; current IRDA overview uses 2,300km². Iskandar is part of the wider JS-SEZ.
features.boundary_warning: Overlaps JS-SEZ and Forest City; never add their areas. Historical expanded-area announcements have different extents.

features.name: Woodlands Gateway
features.summary: Up to 35ha Singapore-side district with industrial, office and transport functions; first phase expected around 2030.
features.location: Woodlands North Coast, Singapore, adjacent to Woodlands North MRT/RTS
features.boundary_warning: Up to 35ha is a proposed district, not all of Woodlands North Coast or Woodlands Regional Centre.

features.name: Johor Bahru–Singapore RTS Link
features.summary: Latest joint release targets February 2027, conditional on independent safety certification and regulatory approvals. Infrastructure substantially complete.

milestones.description: Final system tests and trial runs expected complete

features.journey_time_note: LTA older page says about 5 minutes; MRT Corp current page says 6 minutes. Show roughly 5–6 minutes train time, excluding access, queues and border formalities, or omit precise time.
